summary: Empty-pipeline what_next prefers Project Manager (#660): checkpoints → tick delegated loops → plate_pm_run_cycle dry-run before generic epic prose; live get_what_next loads local pm_status when no open PRs/ready issues.
migration_impact: Agents following plate_what_next / gh plate what-next will be steered to gh plate pm --status|--run|--tick-loops instead of only 'advance an open Epic' text when the PR pipeline is empty. risk_tolerance=off still dry-runs PM; no auto-merge.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core for what_next PM priorities.
2. At cycle start: gh plate what-next --json and honor priority pm_checkpoint|pm_tick|pm.
3. Use plate_pm_run_cycle dry_run first; --apply only when risk and human judgment allow.
4. Ready Features and open PRs still outrank PM.
agent_notes: Closes a Phase-3 gap: orchestrator loop (what_next → assign → budget → checkpoints) is discoverable from the default recommender. Epic #660 may stay open for fuller multi-agent runtime; this slice does not claim browser #661.
